title: Proposal Initiator
description: Which party originated a proposal. Experimental in AdCP 3.3 (media_buy.seller_offers). Absent on a proposal means buyer. A seller-initiated proposal is a seller offer: a committed amendment or negotiated cancellation of an accepted media buy that the buyer accepts, declines, or lets lapse.

enumDescriptions.buyer: Originated by the buyer: a request_proposals or refine_proposals result, including any revision a buyer makes of a seller offer. This is the implied value when proposal_initiator is absent.
enumDescriptions.seller: Originated by the seller as an offer against an accepted media buy. Always committed, always carries offer_reason, and never takes effect until the buyer calls accept_proposal.
